title: For destination computes that have at least 2 completed migrations, return
question: For destination computes that have at least 2 completed migrations, return the destination compute name, the number of completed migrations, the minimum migration memory remaining within that destination compute group, whether any of those migrations involve an instance whose display name is one of the “shelved_offloaded” instances (with system metadata key “image_image_type”) whose total memory exceeds 20000 MB, and only keep destination computes whose completed-migration count is greater than the average completed-migration count across all destination computes. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH completed_migrations AS (
  SELECT
    m.dest_compute,
    m.id AS migration_id,
    m.memory_remaining,
    m.instance_uuid
  FROM migrations m
  WHERE m.status = 'completed'
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT
    cm.dest_compute,
    COUNT(cm.migration_id) AS completed_count,
    MIN(cm.memory_remaining) AS min_memory_remaining,
    MAX(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM instances i
      JOIN instance_system_metadata sm ON sm.instance_uuid = i.uuid
      WHERE i.uuid = cm.instance_uuid
        AND i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
        AND sm.`key` = 'image_image_type'
        AND i.memory_mb > 20000
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_shelved_offloaded_large_instance
  FROM completed_migrations cm
  GROUP BY cm.dest_compute
),
avg_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(completed_count) AS avg_completed_count
  FROM group_stats
)
SELECT
  gs.dest_compute,
  gs.completed_count,
  gs.min_memory_remaining,
  CASE WHEN gs.has_shelved_offloaded_large_instance = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_shelved_offloaded_large_instance
FROM group_stats gs
CROSS JOIN avg_stats a
WHERE gs.completed_count >= 2
  AND gs.completed_count > a.avg_completed_count

SELECT
  g.dest_compute,
  g.completed_count,
  g.min_memory_remaining,
  g.has_shelved_big
FROM (
  SELECT
    m.dest_compute,
    COUNT(*) AS completed_count,
    MIN(m.memory_remaining) AS min_memory_remaining,
    MAX(CASE WHEN i.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded'
                  AND i.memory_mb > 20000
                  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM instance_system_metadata sm
                              WHERE sm.instance_uuid = i.uuid
                                AND sm.`key` = 'image_image_type')
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_shelved_big
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  WHERE m.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY m.dest_compute
) g
WHERE g.completed_count >= 2
  AND g.completed_count > (
    SELECT AVG(c) FROM (
      SELECT COUNT(*) AS c
      FROM migrations
      WHERE status = 'completed'
      GROUP BY dest_compute
    ) t
  )
ORDER BY g.dest_compute;
